analyst.summary: Aurobindo FY26: revenue +6.1% to Rs.33,653cr, PAT Rs.3,503cr, EBITDA margin ~20.4%, but sequential PAT growth is decelerating (Q3 +7.6% YoY -> Q4 +2.0% YoY) and US formulations (40% of sales) fell -13% YoY in Q4. Europe is the standout (+30% YoY, crossed EUR1bn for FY26) and API/Growth-Markets are recovering. The key fresh risk is USFDA OAI status (11 observations) at Eugia Unit-III, the injectables/biosimilar site central to the margin-expansion bull case, alongside separate 483s at two other sites. Valuation (~24-25x TTM P/E) is above both 10-yr median and peer median, with consensus target roughly at spot. Section-232 tariffs currently exempt generics (Aurobindo's core business) but carry a 1-year scope-review clause.
